translations.web: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
translations.bsb: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
translations.kjv: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean
translations.asv: And the hare, because she cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, she is unclean unto you.
